license_declaration.open_game_content: OGL 1.0a (Wizards of the Coast), inlined verbatim per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md §2.2
license_declaration.product_identity_source: Paizo Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Advanced Player's Guide, OGL §15 Product Identity section
license_declaration.product_identity_note: Named deities, NPCs, and unique places are Product Identity per the book's own OGL Section 15 declaration; core class/spell/equipment MECHANICS are Open Game Content.

classification_method_note: This book's license field was populated by a heuristic first-pass screen: a plain substring scan of every `description` value against a documented, bounded term list (the 20 canonical core Golarion deities plus a sampled set of known setting place names -- see scripts/sd27_apg_license_retrofit.py). This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it will not catch Product Identity that is not one of the exact proper nouns on that list (e.g. a paraphrased reference, or a named person/place this list does not include). Scan result for this book: 0 of 641 records matched any blacklist term -- every spell/equipment description sampled during this cycle referenced game mechanics only (no proper-noun PI observed), consistent with the same finding recorded for the Core Rulebook in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md §2.3.

operator_sign_off.note: Set true only after an operator has reviewed this book's classification pass, per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's DRAFT header. This is a heuristic screening pass, not a certified legal clearance.
